text:
Gagne (pronounced Gone-yay): 
Was he French himself?  Yes, pretty sure. 
From somewhere else? He could have been born in Germany or Belgium , I don't know
Where was he when he died? No - he did not die. He was still alive when I got medivac out. He did seem to care much for Lowry. Lowry was an alcoholic and Gagne didn't seem to drink much that I noticed. 

When Dong Xoai was hit and you were on the radio - were you up on the radio mountain or down at the radio van in Saigon? On top the radio mountain. They couldn't get Saigon because there was no direct path and the ran and wind was blowing 100 mph. Going out the door of the french fort would knock you down. There was no aircraft up to help the guys at Dong Xoai at all, everything was grounded. That's why the Vietcong attacked because they knew none of the helicopters could fly and the Jets can't fly. We had A1E's which looks like a P47, but it can't fly or see with the wind and rain.
